label: Define the full sales-report interval, event scope and required calls/products/accounts/cost measures
definition: Learn to match every actual event timestamp to the verified interval grid, define all required call/product/volume/new-account/cost fields and retain complete current inclusion, unit and source rules. Distinguish calls from successful contacts, new accounts from repeated calls and actual sales/cost events from quotes or plans. Retain unknown timestamps or unprovided definitions without treating them as zero or guessing the period.
source: Capability Atlas individually authored profession pathways v1

assessment.method: Observe the authored task and changed case; record support, actual result, errors and feedback.
criteria: Defines all full current report fields/measures and taught interval membership
Separates events, calls, contacts, accounts, sales quantities and cost units
Retains missing/ambiguous time, source, definition or basis

evidence_basis: Individually authored Atlas proposal. Source facets are mapped in the profession route; no external practitioner review, learner observation or occupational certification is claimed.
input_specification: The instructor teaches a complete actual harmless reporting assignment with one verified common timestamp basis and an explicit chronological interval grid: include events at/after the stated start and before the stated end. Full current call/contact, sold-product/unit/volume, new-account eligibility and cost/currency/period definitions and independent expected event membership are supplied. An event exactly at the end belongs to the next interval; unfamiliar calendars/time zones or monetary conversions need their own method.
output_specification: Defines all full current report fields/measures and taught interval membership; Separates events, calls, contacts, accounts, sales quantities and cost units; Retains missing/ambiguous time, source, definition or basis
